research.title: Oak: Representing numbers up to10million
research.designTakeaway: Use zero as a necessary placeholder; bridge labelled value cards, written digit positions and larger units. Group Finnish thousands by spaces, and do not copy English comma notation.
research.adopted: Counters/cards linked to numeral; zero examples and general larger-place principle.
research.rejected: No English separator commas, copied slides or compulsory spoken number-word performance.
research.usageRestrictions: © Oak National Academy Limited2025, OGL3.0 except stated exceptions; https://www.thenational.academy/legal/terms-and-conditions . Linked original paraphrase and original diagrams only. No copied slide/worksheet/photo/mascot. No video or downloaded slide inspection claimed.

research.title: NCETM: Multiplying by10 – is it OK to just put a zero?
research.designTakeaway: Explain the ten-to-one place relationship before any notation shortcut. The value of a digit depends on its unit; adding a written zero is not adding zero to a number.
research.adopted: Ten labelled cards exchange for one card of the next unit, conserving total.
research.rejected: No blanket “add a zero” rule; no decimals inferred from whole-number models.
research.usageRestrictions: NCETM copyright https://www.ncetm.org.uk/copyright/ describes Crown copyright/OGL with thirdparty exceptions and attribution conditions. Original brief paraphrase; no figures, photos or slides copied.

compare.explain: Tuhannet ovat samat. Satoja: 0 ja 9. Suurempi on 1901.

why: Vertaa ensin tuhansia, sitten satoja: suurin paikka ratkaisee, ei viimeinen numero.

till.say: Kassaan tuli tämä raha. Laita numerokortit oikeisiin lokeroihin.
till.hint: Laske jokaisen lokeron setelit. Tyhjä lokero saa nollan.

why.s: Sadat: lokero on tyhjä, joten paikalle tulee 0.
